name: MNRB
recent: MNRB 正在推进以 RM400.49m 收购 Labuan Re 剩余 80% 股权的交易，因等待 Lloyd's 监管批准，完成期限已延长至 2027 年 1 月 29 日。公司同时完成 2026 财年末期股息（每股 15 仙）的股息再投资计划，发行 11,163,612 股新股，并于 11 月 26 日上市。此外，公司任命 Ahmad Noor Azhari 为集团总裁兼首席执行官。
notable: MNRB 与卖方同意将 Labuan Re 80% 股权收购的 Long Stop Date 从 2026 年 11 月 19 日延长至 2027 年 1 月 29 日，以待 Lloyd's 批准。
2026 财年末期股息（每股 15 仙）的股息再投资计划完成，发行 11,163,612 股新股，占选择再投资股份的约 68.16%。
Ahmad Noor Azhari 获任命为 MNRB Holdings Berhad 集团总裁兼首席执行官。
risks: Labuan Re 收购的完成取决于 Lloyd's 的监管批准，Long Stop Date 已延长至 2027 年 1 月 29 日。
股息再投资计划发行新股，导致现有股东持股被稀释。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM836.5m，环比增长 12.6%，同比微降 0.9%；净利润为 RM183.8m，环比增长 61.6%，同比增长 9.1%；净利率为 22.0%，高于上一季度的 15.3%。

events.what_en: Extended long stop date for Labuan Re acquisition

recent_en: MNRB is proceeding with its RM400.49m acquisition of the remaining 80% stake in Labuan Re, with the completion deadline extended to 29 January 2027 pending Lloyd's regulatory approval. The company also completed the dividend reinvestment plan for its FY2026 final dividend of 15 sen per share, issuing 11,163,612 new shares listed on 26 November. In addition, Ahmad Noor Azhari was appointed as Group President & CEO.
notable_en: MNRB and the vendors agreed to extend the Long Stop Date for the acquisition of an 80% stake in Labuan Re from 19 November 2026 to 29 January 2027, pending Lloyd's approval.

The dividend reinvestment plan for the FY2026 final dividend of 15 sen per share was completed with the issuance of 11,163,612 new shares, representing approximately 68.16% of the shares that would have been issued under the DRP.
Ahmad Noor Azhari was appointed as Group President & CEO of MNRB Holdings Berhad.
risks_en: Completion of the Labuan Re acquisition is subject to Lloyd's regulatory approval, with the Long Stop Date extended to 29 January 2027.
The dividend reinvestment plan issued new shares, resulting in dilution for existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM836.5m, up 12.6% QoQ and down 0.9% YoY; net income was RM183.8m, up 61.6% QoQ and 9.1% YoY; net margin was 22.0%, higher than 15.3% in the previous quarter.
